manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Hostage Taker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Hostage Taker for its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
